action.content: Write a song about innovation with a positive tone that is appealing to teenagers. Put your entire response in double quotation marks.
action.label: context

action.content:
"Hey, feel that doubt creeping in when the screen goes dark?
When everyone else seems to have the perfect spark?
But here's the secret they don't tell you in the feed:
The best ideas bloom right where the fear is seeded.

(Chorus)
So break the mold, let your wild thoughts take flight,
Turn the 'what if' into a blazing light.
Innovation isn't just for the pros or the rich,
It's the quiet voice that says, 'I can do this.'
Yeah, you can do this, watch the future unfold,
A story of courage that's never too old.

(Verse 2)
Maybe you're scared to share your unique code,
Or the path you're walking feels a little too broad.
But every glitch is just a chance to learn and grow,
Every stumble is a step that helps you know.
Connect with friends who see the world through different eyes,
Together we build bridges where there used to be skies.

(Chorus)
So break the mold, let your wild thoughts take flight,
Turn the 'what if' into a blazing light.
Innovation isn't just for the pros or the rich,
It's the quiet voice that says, 'I can do this.'
Yeah, you can do this, watch the future unfold,
A story of courage that's never too old.

(Bridge)
Don't wait for permission, don't wait for the sign,
Your perspective is the rarest, most precious design.
The world needs your voice, your style, your brand new way,
Let's make today the start of a brighter day.

(Chorus)
So break the mold, let your wild thoughts take flight,
Turn the 'what if' into a blazing light.
Innovation isn't just for the pros or the rich,
It's the quiet voice that says, 'I can do this.'
Yeah, you can do this, watch the future unfold,
A story of courage that's never too old.

(Outro)
Keep creating, keep believing, keep moving forward,
The greatest adventures are waiting to be explored.
You've got this, yeah, you've got this,
Let's innovate together, let's make it bliss."
action.label: response
